completion_dependencies: exact Android SDK/API version and terms state recorded
no Android SDK type crosses the P2 public boundary
evidence_ceiling: Static/fake-provider success proves mapping logic only. Physical availability, latency, privacy, actual system-model version and quality require exact LIVE_DEVICE receipts.
goal: Implement an Android system-model adapter behind P2 provider-neutral contracts with explicit capability probing, typed failure mapping and policy-controlled fallback.

handoff_contract.draft_pr_rule: Create a Draft PR only after real implementation bytes and the owning static/local gates exist. A task-packet-only branch must not open a ceremonial PR.
required_fields: consumed parent identities and output digests
positive gates and planted negative controls
evidence lanes and explicit NOT_EXERCISED states

human_owned_operations: merge or retarget any pull request
App Store or Google Play publication
signing, provisioning, credentials, secrets or access grants
model, SDK, store, service or legal terms acceptance
semantic resolution of conflicting public/private/source requirements
production rollback or destructive artifact removal
negative_controls: unsupported device incorrectly reported available -> FAIL
stale capability reused after OS/model revision change -> FAIL
provider SDK type in P2/domain value -> FAIL
system failure silently falls back to network -> FAIL
model tool proposal directly executes side effect -> FAIL
emulator receipt promoted to LIVE_DEVICE -> FAIL
non_goals: put AICore, ML Kit or Android SDK types into contracts/** or domain code
claim all Android devices or OS versions support the same system model
claim emulator/static tests prove physical-device availability, privacy, latency or backend selection
positive_gates: adapter unit tests and fake provider compile
available, unavailable and stale-capability paths are deterministic
cancellation and typed error mapping preserve request/trace identity
public-boundary and provider-type leakage scans pass
required_outputs: capability probe interface and typed capability snapshot
structured-output/tool proposal mapping without side-effect authority
start_dependencies: P2 exact contracts and bindings are readable at the declared parent
P0 source taxonomy identifies current Android system-GenAI docs as rolling and recheck-required
no physical device or accepted SDK terms are required for the fake-provider vertical slice
stop_conditions: P2 parent head/tree or exact-receipt identity drifts
writer lease overlaps another ACTIVE worker
provider-specific types cross the shared P2 contract boundary
private Workspace URL, resolver value, secret or private decision enters public Git
a cheaper evidence lane is promoted into LIVE_DEVICE, PRIVATE or HUMAN acceptance

worker_prompt_envelope.shadow: Run as a separate observer. Classify material deltas as ASSUMPTION, STATE, AUTHORITY, OWNERSHIP, LIFECYCLE, CONCURRENCY, RESOURCE, SIDE_EFFECT, FAILURE, or EVIDENCE. Return L0, L1, L2, or L3 without silently editing implementation.
worker_prompt_envelope.tech_lead: Preserve start-readiness versus completion-readiness, exact-subject receipts, disjoint worker leases, failure falsifiers, and Local Handoff boundaries.
